competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times. The first attack decreases their Attack Power for 2 turns, and the second attack disturbs their HP recovery for 2 turns.
Attacks all enemies to destroy the enemy's MAX HP by 50% of the damage dealt. Griffin recovers its HP according to the enemy's destroyed MAX HP.
Decreases the damage Griffin takes and increases the damage Griffin deals in proportion to the enemy's destroyed MAX HP. [Automatic Effect]
Griffin is not affected by skills that decrease the Attack Bar, and its Attack Bar increases by 20% whenever the enemy gains a turn. [Automatic Effect]
